desc:
Anime Event

🐾 A slap on the dummy. A flight across the map. Which cat will appear when it falls?

🎯 Tap at the right moment to land the perfect hit! The farther the dummy flies, the greater the luck of the biome where it lands. When it lands, keep an eye on the silhouettes. Can you recognize the cat before the reveal? 👀

🏡 Take your cats to the farm and place them on pedestals to earn money per second. Want to find your best team? Use Equip Best to place the highest-earning cats on the pedestals!

💪 Train on the bar to gain strength and send the dummy even further. Improve your equipment, reach new biomes, and expand the farm to have space for more cats.

🤝 Earn +10% more income per friend in the same server.
✨ Discover rare cats and see the special revelation of the Eternals.
📖 Complete the Index, from Common to Secret!
